constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the TextureProcessor class.

property.name: ColorKeyColor
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual Color ColorKeyColor { get; set; }
property.value: The color used when a texture is color keyed.

property.name: ColorKeyEnabled
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool ColorKeyEnabled { get; set; }
property.value: true if color keying is enabled; false otherwise.

property.name: GenerateMipmaps
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool GenerateMipmaps { get; set; }
property.value: true if mipmap generation is enabled; false otherwise.

property.name: PremultiplyAlpha
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: [DefaultValueAttribute(true)] public virtual bool PremultiplyAlpha { get; set; }
property.value: true if alpha premultiply is enabled; false otherwise.

property.name: ResizeToPowerOfTwo
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual bool ResizeToPowerOfTwo { get; set; }
property.value: true if resizing is enabled; false otherwise.

property.name: TextureFormat
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.syntax: public virtual TextureProcessorOutputFormat TextureFormat { get; set; }
property.value: The texture format of the output.

overload.remarks: Process generates mipmaps if they are not already present, but leaves the texture in the same format as the input data. This is suitable for use with DDS files that have already been converted to an appropriate format.
